# Spill Kit Sizer

> Answer four questions and get a spill kit recommendation: universal, oil-only or hazmat, the absorbent capacity you need, and extras like drain covers, booms and neutralizers.

Spill Kit Sizer (https://spill-kit-sizer.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Spill Prevention & Response, Awareness training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://spill-kit-sizer.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://spill-kit-sizer.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training): $29.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 40 CFR 112. Preventing spills and responding safely. Enroll: https://spill-kit-sizer.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training?buy=416
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://spill-kit-sizer.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Knowing when a spill is too big for the kit. Enroll: https://spill-kit-sizer.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099

## Guides

- [Where to put spill kits](https://spill-kit-sizer.hazwoperosha.us/guides/where-to-put-spill-kits): A spill kit across the building doesn't help. Placement rules that work.
- [Spill kit inspection checklist](https://spill-kit-sizer.hazwoperosha.us/guides/spill-kit-inspection-checklist): A monthly two-minute check that keeps kits ready.
